hooks.command: root="${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -n "$root" ]; then hook="$root/bin/hook.py"; else hook=; for candidate in /opt/.devin/plugins_cache/cache/github.com_Uraxii_dotai_plugins_ox-vibesec-*/*/bin/hook.py; do [ -f "$candidate" ] || continue; if [ -z "$hook" ] || [ "$candidate" -nt "$hook" ]; then hook="$candidate"; fi; done; fi; if [ ! -f "$hook" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'ox-vibesec: plugin root not found' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec python3 -B "$hook" SessionStart
